comparison.objective: Retrieve toast safely after unplugging a toaster, versus commissioning and locking an adjustable axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a sprung lift lever and extract toast with tongs; no fine setscrew/collar adjustment or response-driven tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Toast on plate, toaster unplugged, forbidden fork untouched, lever and tools cleared; no dynamic stopping, travel, rebound, or force criteria.
comparison.reason: The safety sequence and generic bimanual/tool primitives are shared, but the tested manipulation and outcome are meaningfully different.
